description: Search every file of a site for a literal string or a regular expression: the served files by default, or the editable source tree with target 'source'. Use it before reading files in bulk, to find the ones that matter.

maxMatches.description: Cap on returned matches. Default 200, hard max 1000. Truncation is reported via budgetExceeded.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

pattern.description: Text to find (ASCII, max 500 chars). Literal unless regex is true.

regex.description: When true, pattern is an extended regular expression (BusyBox grep -E, no PCRE). Default false: literal match.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

target.description: 'dist' (default) searches the served files; 'source' searches the editable source tree (get_site.sourceStored).

name: search_files

budgetExceeded.description: True if the search hit maxMatches and there are likely more matches not returned.

content.description: The matched line. Truncated to 240 chars to keep responses bounded.

title: Grep across a site's files
